_comment: Transcribed from an in-game screenshot taken 2026-08-01 (Steam capture index 125 in the 16:03 run). Gadget screens carry a name, a model designation and a description but no stat block or trait chips, so this item has no stats or ratings. Art is cropped from the same shot. The page leads with the model designation because that is what EA's patch notes use.
name: Sniper Decoy

description.text: A dummy designed to draw the enemy's attention while you fire from a safer location. Taking up position near a friendly Sniper Decoy will hide your scope glint with its own. Replicates the stance of the owner when placed and is immediately spotted, marking its position in-world and on the enemy's minimap.

_unlock_note: Unlock recorded 2026-08-02 from Battlefield 6's own in-game unlock and challenge data. Not from the screenshot cited above: unlock text only displays in-game on items the account does not own.
